result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.influence_maximization()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Find the k most influential nodes for information spread. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16088-L16156){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.influence_maximization( k, model="independent_cascade", probability=0.1, n_simulations=100, seed=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses a greedy algorithm to select seed nodes that maximize the expected spread in an Independent Cascade model. Useful for identifying key regulatory genes or optimal drug targets in signaling networks. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of seed nodes to select. [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["independent_cascade"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Diffusion model. Currently only `"independent_cascade"` is supported. [probability]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.1]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Per-edge activation probability in each cascade step. [n_simulations]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of Monte Carlo simulations per candidate evaluation. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed for reproducibility. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return a list of `(node_id, marginal_gain)` tuples. If `False`, store the result and return `self` for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph | list[tuple[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The selected seed nodes with their marginal gains (if `return_dict=True`) or `self`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#882d2a65 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph() for i in range(6): g.add_node(label=str(i)) for i in range(5): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(i + 1)) seeds = g.influence_maximization(k=2, probability=0.5, seed=42, return_dict=True) seeds ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [(3, 2.69), (5, 1.27)] ``` ::: :::
